"September 9th, 1976. The man who ruled a quarter of humanity... is dead.

**[0:20 — Music rises: pulsing strings. Quick cuts — Jiang Qing at the funeral, three men at her side.]**

**NARRATOR (V.O.)**:
"His widow. Her three loyalists. The Gang of Four. They control the airwaves. They command the radicals. And they are ready to seize *everything*.

**TEXT CARD:** *"With you in charge, I am at ease."*

**[0:35 — Heartbeat returns. Whispered meetings. Guards in dark corridors. A motorcade at night.]**

**NARRATOR (V.O.)**:
"No election. No law. Only loyalty... and betrayal. In the shadows, an old marshal waits. And the Chairman's own bodyguards... choose their moment."

**[0:46 — ALL SOUND CUTS TO SILENCE. A door swings open.]**

**NARRATOR (V.O.)**:
"October 6th. The Gang of Four are called to a meeting..."

*[A beat. A door SLAMS.]*

"...they will never leave."

**[0:54 — TITLE CARD rises from black:]**

# **THE DEATH OF MAO**

**NARRATOR (V.O.)** *(almost a whisper)*:

**[SMASH CUT TO BLACK. One final heartbeat. END.]**
